title: Shaming Microloan Delinquents: Evidence from a Field Experiment in China
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment (VIS/LIS disclosure messages vs control). Table 3 cols 1-4 are cross-sectional probit comparisons; cols 5-8 are a DiD on 208 repeat borrowers estimated as a fixed-effect probit (marginal effects) of monthly delinquency on VIS x post with a treated-group dummy, controls, and month and village (not borrower) FE, with one intervention date for all treated borrowers. Nonlinear, not staggered, and the repeat-borrower panel is not shipped.
design_notes: Equation (2): y_it = b0 + b1 VIS_i x post_t + b2 X_it + Month_t + Village_j. main_program_revision.do contains only the cross-sectional probits (Table 3 cols 1-4, Tables 5-7); comments state repeat-borrower data/code and the supplementary experiment cannot be disclosed.
data_files_note: Shipped files cover the post-intervention borrower-month data for the cross-sectional comparisons; the 12-month pre-period repayment history for repeat borrowers (DiD, Table 3 cols 5-8) is withheld under the partner agreement.
data_provenance_note: DiD panel not shipped; cross-sectional experiment data shipped are original.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2021.4007.txt). Management Science 2022, 68(5):3768-3790.
